@copilot Update this PR directly with the user's requested replacement approach: use literal Muzzle group, module, and version fields and remove metadata-parser interpolation. This supersedes the coordinate-interpolation implementation currently in this PR. The user explicitly requested this revision with /cloud after discussing inlining the remaining Muzzle fields and simplifying the parser.

In instrumentation/play/play-mvc/play-mvc-2.6/javaagent/build.gradle.kts, make the Scala 2 coordinate and ranges literal: play_2.11 and [2.6.0,) for all three Scala 2 passes. Preserve the org.playframework:play_3 range (,) already in this PR. In instrumentation/zio/zio-2.0/javaagent/build.gradle.kts, inline [2.0.0,) in all three passes. In instrumentation/zio/zio-http-3.0/javaagent/build.gradle.kts, inline [3.0.0,) in all three passes. These are ten remaining interpolated fields across three builds on the current PR head. Check for any additional production Muzzle group/module/versions interpolation requiring the same treatment. Preserve every existing assertInverse, skip entry, supported range, and dependency declaration. Keep version and Scala constants still used by dependency declarations; do not remove unrelated constants in gRPC, Ktor, or other builds.

In instrumentation-docs/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/docs/parsers/GradleParser.java, remove interpolate(), extractVariables(), variablePattern, and the now-unneeded variable-map parameters/imports. Construct the dependency summary directly from literal group, module, and versionRange values. Add small, clear fail-fast validation that rejects variable references or other nonliteral arguments in those fields of nonignored external-artifact pass blocks, instead of emitting unresolved coordinates or silently dropping such a block. Cover both $name and ${name} interpolation and direct variable arguments without introducing a Kotlin evaluator or general parser redesign. Preserve coreJdk handling, instrumentation-docs:ignore behavior, library handling, and unrelated parsing behavior.

Update instrumentation-docs/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/docs/parsers/GradleParserTest.java: replace the existing ZIO variable fixture with literals and replace the newly added interpolation regression with literal Play coordinate/range coverage. Add focused rejection coverage for nonliteral/interpolated group, module, and versions fields, including an ignored pass that must not cause rejection. Document the literal-only Muzzle field convention in the appropriate existing contributor documentation, making clear that constants in dependency declarations are still allowed.

Do not edit docs/instrumentation-list.yaml or the metadata workflow; the nightly workflow owns generated catalog updates. Keep the work in this same PR and avoid unrelated changes. Run the narrow existing formatter and parser validation and the affected existing Muzzle validation appropriate to this change. Acceptance requires no interpolation helper or variable extraction in GradleParser, literal production Muzzle fields, explicit rejection of unsupported nonliteral fields, preserved ignored/core-JDK behavior, and generated targets including com.typesafe.play:play_2.11:[2.6.0,) and org.playframework:play_3:(,).

@copilot Update this PR directly with the test simplification the user requested via /cloud. Limit coding changes to instrumentation-docs/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/docs/parsers/GradleParserTest.java. Preserve the production parser, literal Muzzle fields, dependency constants, ranges, documentation, and generated-catalog policy.

Combine testExtractMuzzleVersions_PlayCoordinates and testExtractMuzzleVersions_MultiplePassBlocks into one concise multiple-pass test with just two literal Play passes: com.typesafe.play:play_2.11:[2.6.0,) and org.playframework:play_3:(,). Keep the exact two expected coordinates inline in containsExactlyInAnyOrder. Remove the redundant Play Scala 2 variants, ZIO fixture, and fixture-only plugin boilerplate.

Reduce testRejectsNonLiteralMuzzleFields from the nine-case cross-product to three representative assignments: group.set(playGroup), module.set("$playModule"), and versions.set("${versionRange}"). Keep assertions that these throw IllegalArgumentException with the literal-string error. Inline the single-use parseMuzzlePass helper call directly in the assertion lambda and remove that helper; do not introduce a replacement test abstraction or case generator.

Fold testDocsIgnoreSkipsNonLiteralMuzzlePass into the existing testDocsIgnoreSkipsPassBlock. Use a nonliteral group, module, and versions in its ignored middle pass, retaining ${name} interpolation there and a valid pass after it. Preserve the assertion for the two valid surrounding ranges so this still verifies ignored fields do not cause rejection and that an interpolation closing brace does not truncate the parser's block matching. Remove the separate redundant ignored-nonliteral test. Preserve the separate ignored core-JDK and marker-above-pass tests.

Replace separate size and stream().findFirst() assertions in this file with containsExactly(...) on info.versions(), preserving minimum-Java-version assertions and the distinct core-JDK, conditional-Java, marker-placement, literal-field and rejection coverage. Keep the cleanup small and readable. Run the narrow existing formatter and GradleParserTest validation; do not change production behavior, build files, or docs. Acceptance requires fewer duplicated fixtures and no single-use parseMuzzlePass helper while all the distinct behavior above remains covered.
